record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four units in appliesTo declare GROWL in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats.
record.summary: No damage: every enemy in the 8 cells around the caster is flinched for 3000 ms and loses attack (raw 3/5/7/14 by caster stars, scaled by the caster's AP and crit).

targeting.who: enemy units in the cells adjacent to the caster (not adjacent to the cast target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true, so a target in range is needed to cast; the target parameter is only used by super.process for the animation. How the target is picked before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: the 8 board cells around the caster (3x3 minus centre), clipped to the board

effects.scaling: apBoost 1: round(-raw x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if the cast crit). Crit needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false.
effects.resolution: requested = -raw. applied = the rounded scaled value, then Big Eater Belt is not applied (enemy-sourced negative value), a Twist Band holder turns it into a BUFF of the same size, and ATK is floored at 1. Not permanent. No SPE_DEF, shield or damage step is involved.

statusEffects.applicationOrder: before the ATK debuff for the same enemy
statusEffects.guards: not applied if runeProtect; duration passes through applyStatusDurationReductions (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, HYDRATION x0.5, WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, then 10% per Odd Keystone); a new flinch replaces the remaining time only if longer
statusEffects.combatEffect: while flinched, damage that would hit a shield is split: half is dealt to the shield and half is residual damage to HP (PokemonState.handleDamage); a unit with curse of vulnerability is also re-flinched for 30000 ms whenever it is not flinched. Other uses of status.flinch in app/core and app/models were searched by name; other directories were not.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (14, also the fallback) is not reachable by the four units' bare star counts. maxPP and range are in appliesTo.

record.positionalConditions: Only enemies in cells touching the caster are affected; with none adjacent the cast does nothing besides the PP reset.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Repeated casts stack the ATK debuff each time (not permanent) and extend flinch only if longer.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: ATK -3/-5/-7/-14 by caster stars and flinch 3000 ms. Resolved ATK change = rounded AP/crit scaled value, which a Twist Band holder inverts; flinch duration is shortened by the status duration reductions listed.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, target selection before the cast, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
How basic attack damage uses the reduced ATK stat (not traced here)
Other effects reacting to a stat change or a flinch outside the files named in the evidence
unresolved: Whether any item or synergy effect changes GROWL beyond Twist Band and the duration reductions listed
Units not listed in appliesTo that might share the identifier are not covered
